chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari narrated to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Muhammad ibn Hammad al-Kufi, from Ibrahim ibn Musa al-Ansari, who said: Mus'ab narrated to me from Jabir, from Muhammad ibn 'Ali (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever is pleased to live my life and die my death and enter my Paradise—the Garden of Eden, whose trees my Lord planted with His own hand—should follow 'Ali, recognize his merit and that of the successors after him, and dissociate from my enemies. Allah has given them my understanding and my knowledge. They are my progeny, from my flesh and blood. I complain to my Lord about their enemies from among my nation, those who deny their virtues and cut off the tie of kinship with them. By Allah, my son will be killed, and then they will not attain my intercession.
ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for entering Paradise according to the Prophet's statement about 'Ali and his successors?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes the theological link between following the Prophet, loving 'Ali, and recognizing the Imams as the criterion for Paradise, while predicting the martyrdom of Husayn. It highlights the concept of *Wala'* (loyalty) and *Bara'* (dissociation), noting that the Imams possess the Prophet's knowledge and that his enemies will be excluded from his intercession (*Shafa'ah*).

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 7. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥammād Al-Kūfi, from Ibrāhīm ibn Mūsā Al-Ansāri, from Mus’ab, from Jābir (Al-Ju’fi), from Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)), who said:

The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) said: Those who want to live like me, die like me, and enter my Paradise – the forever green Paradise whose trees my Lord planted with His own hand –should follow ‘Ali (a.s.), learn his merits and that of the successors after him, and dissociate from my enemies. (Verily) Allāh has given them (‘Ali and his successors (a.s.)) my knowledge and my understanding. (Verily) they are my descendants who are from my flesh and blood. I complain to Allāh about their enemies from my nation, about those who deny their virtues, and about those who abandon me by (oppressing) them. I swear to Allāh that they will kill my son. May Allāh exclude them from my intercession.
